mapper.select: SELECT rt.id, rt.task_no, rt.event_id, rt.assignee_id, rt.dispatcher_id, rt.status, rt.priority, rt.dispatch_at, rt.accept_at, rt.arrive_at, rt.complete_at, rt.result_type, rt.result_note, rt.result_photo_urls, rt.created_at, rt.updated_at, rt.deleted, rt.task_location, u1.real_name AS assignee_name, u1.phone AS assignee_phone, u2.real_name AS dispatcher_name, ae.event_no AS event_no, ae.snapshot_url AS snapshot_url, ae.source_device_id AS source_device_id, ae.confidence AS confidence, ae.alert_type AS alert_type, d.device_name AS source_device_name, d.device_code AS source_device_code FROM rescue_task rt LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON rt.assignee_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON rt.dispatcher_id = u2.id LEFT JOIN alert_event ae ON rt.event_id = ae.id LEFT JOIN device d ON ae.source_device_id = d.id WHERE rt.id = #{id} AND rt.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rescue_task ( task_no, event_id, assignee_id, dispatcher_id, status, task_location, priority, dispatch_at, accept_at, arrive_at, complete_at, result_type, result_note, result_photo_urls, created_at, updated_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{task.taskNo}, #{task.eventId}, #{task.assigneeId}, #{task.dispatcherId}, COALESCE(#{task.status}, 'DISPATCHED'), #{task.taskLocation}, COALESCE(#{task.priority}, 1), COALESCE(#{task.dispatchAt}, NOW()), #{task.acceptAt}, #{task.arriveAt}, #{task.completeAt}, #{task.resultType}, #{task.resultNote}, #{task.resultPhotoUrls, typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}, COALESCE(#{task.createdAt}, NOW()), COALESCE(#{task.updatedAt}, NOW()), 0 )
mapper.update:
UPDATE rescue_task
task_no = #{task.taskNo}, event_id = #{task.eventId}, assignee_id = #{task.assigneeId}, dispatcher_id = #{task.dispatcherId}, status = #{task.status}, task_location = #{task.taskLocation}, priority = #{task.priority}, dispatch_at = #{task.dispatchAt}, accept_at = #{task.acceptAt}, arrive_at = #{task.arriveAt}, complete_at = #{task.completeAt}, result_type = #{task.resultType}, result_note = #{task.resultNote},
result_photo_urls = #{task.resultPhotoUrls, typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler},
updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = #{task.id}
